brief: Priority 1 is to enter at map reference (29.63822, -89.95027); a crew entering here is closest to 7 isolated buildings [F3]. 67 road pieces were checked: 33 judged flooded, 14 uncertain, and the rest judged dry [F1]. 7 buildings are isolated, cut off from every exit road, 0 uncertain, 0 still reachable, and 0 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. Testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles found 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings marked reachable, with 'isolated' calls right roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off, so treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off [F4]. Flood judgements come from a vision model reading satellite photos and are not field-verified; uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F5].
